data.title: 中野五月 · 星空天台的月色真美
data.description: 夜幕降临的校园天台仰望无垠星河，五月双手捧着温热的灌装咖啡。银白月光洒在她认真的面庞上，真诚而温柔地开导着少年心底的迷茫。
data.action: looking up at stars, holding warm canned drink, earnest solemn gaze
data.lighting: 星空天台漫天繁星银辉与城市暖调夜光
data.promptProse: Beneath a breathtaking starry night sky filled with the Milky Way, Nakano Itsuki stands on the school rooftop holding a warm canned drink. Silver moonlight illuminates her long flowing reddish hair and star hairpins as she gazes sincerely at the viewer.
data.animaCaption: A canopy of sparkling stars and distant rooftop lights shine down on Itsuki enjoying an intimate late-night chat.
